the phase 2 enzyme inducers in broccoli sprout extracts, including the isothiocyanates sulforaphane and erucin, are safe and efficacious when topically applied to human skin, and that they are promising candidates for use in skin protection against UV light.
broccoli sprout extracts, containing the isothiocyanates sulforaphane and/or erucin, are safe and effective inducers of the phase 1/2 response in mouse and human skin.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that sulforaphane is the major bioactive compound in broccoli sprout extracts that induces phase 2 enzymes in human and mouse skin and that topical application of broccoli sprout extract is safe and effective in humans.
the topical application of a broccoli sprout extract that delivers sulforaphane to the skin is safe and effective at inducing phase 2 enzymes.
the topical application of sulfoaphane-containing broccoli extracts to mouse and human skin induces the phase 2 detoxification response.
The main takeaway from our work is that
broccoli extracts are safe and efficacious in inducing the phase 2 detoxification response in mouse and human skin.
topical application of sulfoaphane-containing broccoli extracts is safe in humans, and it induces the phase 2 enzyme response in both mouse and human skin.

topical application of sulfoaphane-containing broccoli extracts induces the phase 2 enzymes NQO1, GSTA1, and HO-1 in mouse and human skin and thus may provide protection against UV-induced DNA damage and skin cancer.
